messages:
michelle: kicking off staged rollout v3.2.1. plan: EU -> US, 0% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100%. change window 02:00-03:00 UTC. can someone own the 5% stop/go? :eyes:

sam_dev: I can watch metrics for the first slice. share release notes and canary prompt set?

michelle: release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/v3.2.1.md  (contains perf/regression notes + rollout checklist). prompt set: https://evals/internal/canary-3.2.1

deploy-bot: /deploy start canary v3.2.1 --slices "eu:5%,us:0%" --change-window 2026-03-22T02:00Z/2026-03-22T03:00Z

deploy-bot: STATUS: initiated slice eu:5% (allocating servers). build: redwood/v3.2.1@sha256:abc123 -> serving nodes 12/12

jack_o: seeing a small bump in tail latency (p50 ~ stable, p99 +120ms) in eu-canary after ~30s. not sure if it's noise. posting grafana link: https://grafana.company/r/abcd123

sam_dev: looking at errors, 5xx rate still within baseline but slow tails align with longer contexts from a handful of requests. sampling now.

ryan_sre: request hold at 5% until we confirm KV cache warming isn't the cause. prefer to pause rollout for 10m to inspect.

michelle: hold called. pausing progress. marking rollback conditions: if 5xx > 0.5% for 5m or p99 latency > +250ms vs baseline.

nina_pm: +1 to hold. can we pin EU traffic to v3.2.0 if we need to rollback quickly? need the pin ready for legal/regulatory EU customers.

michelle: yes. pin command is ready: `deploy-bot pin-version eu v3.2.0` (we tested it in staging).

sam_dev: quick smoke sampling from the 5% bucket shows 12 requests with longer decode times, but quality looks fine. attaching sample traces: `trace-789`

jack_o: after clearing caches on a single host, p99 dropped back close to baseline. looks like KV warmup + long prefixes caused the spike.

ryan_sre: recommend resume when cache hit ratio > 80% or after 8m.

michelle: agree. resuming readiness countdown: resume in 6m if no regressions reported. please ack when you continue monitoring. :thumbsup:

sam_dev: acked, I'll keep eyes on error budget and quality evals.

deploy-bot: RESUME scheduled in 360s. next slice command (manual): `/deploy promote canary v3.2.1 --to 25% --regions eu,us`

michelle: will call stop/go at 25%. leaving this thread open for updates. if anyone sees red, post here and we will cancel promote and run `deploy-bot pin-version eu v3.2.0`.

nina_pm: documented in the change log and added a note for support to prepare rollback messages if needed.

deploy-bot: NOTE: audit event created: rollout:v3.2.1:user:michelle @ 4765432100

michelle: thanks everyone.
